text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus returned
after finishing the race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The results of the adjustments fell below our initial expectations... That must be what happened.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it is entirely due to my own poor self-management.
At this rate, achieving my goals will be...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot let it end like this.
I will make a comeback, without fail."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To run longer than anyone,
and to win more than anyone...!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Tannhauser-san once told me there's
something you're supposed to do at times like this.
Trainer-san, let's go."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now then, towards the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that, the motivation was completely restored!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Even if you understand it in your head, things rarely go as planned.
At times like this—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Grabbing a cup of tea, that is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Drinking deeply astringent tea clears your head with its bitterness.
...That was Nature-san's advice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I have already scouted a Japanese-style cafe that serves strong green tea. Let us go together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You said, “I'd be over the moon just to bury my face in a cat,” but... I wonder if we'll actually find one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, drinking some strong green tea helped switch gears for the next challenge.
